description: The 'commits' dataset provides detailed information about software project commits, capturing essential metadata and change details. This dataset is particularly useful for software development teams, project managers, and researchers interested in analyzing code changes over time. Each entry in the dataset represents a unique commit, identified by a 'commit_id', and is associated with a specific 'project_key'. The dataset includes the 'author' of the commit, providing insights into team contributions. The 'timestamp' column records when each commit was made, allowing for chronological analysis of project development. Additionally, the dataset tracks the number of 'added_files', 'added_lines', 'removed_files', 'removed_lines', and 'changed_files', offering a comprehensive view of the modifications made in each commit. This information can be used to assess the impact of individual commits, track project progress, and identify trends in code development. Overall, the dataset serves as a valuable resource for understanding the dynamics of software development and the contributions of individual team members.
shortDesc: Software project commit dataset with metadata and change details.

columns.name: project_key
columns.comment: Unique identifier for the software project.

columns.name: author
columns.comment: Name or identifier of the commit author.

columns.name: timestamp
columns.comment: Time when the commit was made, in milliseconds.

columns.name: added_files
columns.comment: Number of files added in the commit.

columns.name: added_lines
columns.comment: Number of lines added in the commit.

columns.name: removed_files
columns.comment: Number of files removed in the commit.

columns.name: removed_lines
columns.comment: Number of lines removed in the commit.

columns.name: changed_files
columns.comment: Number of files changed in the commit.
